与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:利奥的经历、感受与成长。

At first, Leo found it difficult to keep the habit. The discount area looked quieter than usual that evening. Leo wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What's more, some shops still offer cash on delivery.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Leo prefers cloudy weather when running in the gym. For example, he kept hacking at the frozen ground with a spade.

People around Leo often share different ideas about the discount area. The experience taught Leo more than any book could. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Last orders at half nine.

Leo thanked David for the honest advice. David always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Leo has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. The frail old man crossed the street with a nurse's help.
The shopping mall has become an important part of daily life. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Leo's dream job is to be a teacher.
